## English

- Improves the Android conversation composer and adds more actions to the conversation menu.
- Adds transport heartbeat diagnostics and Noise IK golden-vector coverage for easier connection troubleshooting and protocol maintenance.
- Fixes the Windows uninstall path when optional plugins are missing and refreshes the committed Host bundle.
- Publishes the Android app as version `0.4.26` with Android `versionCode 37`.

Thanks to [@luojiyin1987](https://github.com/luojiyin1987) for the transport diagnostics, Noise IK test vectors, and Host bundle work; [@LeaningLearner](https://github.com/LeaningLearner) for the Android workspace/tool picker and image-prompt fixes; and [@dreamfarer-space](https://github.com/dreamfarer-space) for the Windows uninstall fix. Thank you to everyone who tested, reviewed, and shared feedback across the recent releases.

## 中文

- 优化 Android 对话输入区，并增加对话页更多操作菜单。
- 增加传输心跳诊断与 Noise IK golden vector 覆盖，方便排查连接问题并维护协议实现。
- 修复可选插件缺失时的 Windows 卸载流程，并刷新已提交的 Host bundle。
- 发布版本 `0.4.26` 的 Android App（Android `versionCode 37`）。

感谢 [@luojiyin1987](https://github.com/luojiyin1987) 贡献传输诊断、Noise IK 测试向量和 Host bundle 工作；感谢 [@LeaningLearner](https://github.com/LeaningLearner) 贡献 Android 工作区/工具选择器与图片 Prompt 修复；感谢 [@dreamfarer-space](https://github.com/dreamfarer-space) 贡献 Windows 卸载修复。也感谢近期几个版本中参与测试、评审和反馈的每一位朋友。
